title: Sales and demand: fast and slow movers
description: Which medicines sell the most and least, and how cold-chain medicines compare.

list.name: disease_category
list.label: Disease category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT disease_category FROM mart.dim_medicine WHERE is_current AND medicine_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Net sales
panels.description: Net sales of the medicines in view over the selected window (last N months of data).

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) AS last_month FROM mart.agg_sales_month),
vol AS (
  SELECT a.medicine_id, sum(a.quantity_sold_packs) AS packs, sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd) AS net
  FROM mart.agg_sales_month a, bounds b
  WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date > b.last_month - ($window || ' months')::interval
  GROUP BY 1),
ranked AS (
  SELECT m.medicine_id, m.generic_name, m.therapeutic_class, m.disease_category, m.cold_chain_flag,
         coalesce(v.packs, 0) AS packs, coalesce(v.net, 0) AS net,
         rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(v.packs, 0) DESC) AS fast_rank,
         rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(v.packs, 0) ASC) AS slow_rank
  FROM mart.dim_medicine m LEFT JOIN vol v ON v.medicine_id = m.medicine_id
  WHERE m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0 AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)) SELECT round(sum(net)) FROM ranked

panels.title: Disease categories
panels.description: Packs and net sales per disease category in the window. Cold chain = number of cold-chain medicines in the category.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) AS last_month FROM mart.agg_sales_month),
vol AS (
  SELECT a.medicine_id, sum(a.quantity_sold_packs) AS packs, sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd) AS net
  FROM mart.agg_sales_month a, bounds b
  WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date > b.last_month - ($window || ' months')::interval
  GROUP BY 1),
ranked AS (
  SELECT m.medicine_id, m.generic_name, m.therapeutic_class, m.disease_category, m.cold_chain_flag,
         coalesce(v.packs, 0) AS packs, coalesce(v.net, 0) AS net,
         rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(v.packs, 0) DESC) AS fast_rank,
         rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(v.packs, 0) ASC) AS slow_rank
  FROM mart.dim_medicine m LEFT JOIN vol v ON v.medicine_id = m.medicine_id
  WHERE m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0 AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)) SELECT CASE disease_category WHEN 'Pain and Inflammatory Conditions' THEN 'Pain & Inflammation' WHEN 'Neurological and Mental Health Conditions' THEN 'Neuro & Mental Health' WHEN 'Gastrointestinal Disease' THEN 'Gastrointestinal' WHEN 'Cardiovascular Disease' THEN 'Cardiovascular' WHEN 'Respiratory Disease' THEN 'Respiratory' WHEN 'Infectious Disease' THEN 'Infectious' WHEN 'Diabetes Mellitus' THEN 'Diabetes' ELSE disease_category END AS "disease category",
                         count(*) FILTER (WHERE cold_chain_flag) AS "cold chain",
                         sum(packs) AS packs, round(sum(net), 0) AS "net sales (USD)"
                  FROM ranked GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Detail: cold-chain medicines and the full ranking
Cold-chain medicines
panels.description: The cold-chain medicines: their volume rank is low (out of 63) but their revenue per pack is high.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT max((year_month || '-01')::date) AS last_month FROM mart.agg_sales_month),
vol AS (
  SELECT a.medicine_id, sum(a.quantity_sold_packs) AS packs, sum(a.net_sales_amount_usd) AS net
  FROM mart.agg_sales_month a, bounds b
  WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date > b.last_month - ($window || ' months')::interval
  GROUP BY 1),
ranked AS (
  SELECT m.medicine_id, m.generic_name, m.therapeutic_class, m.disease_category, m.cold_chain_flag,
         coalesce(v.packs, 0) AS packs, coalesce(v.net, 0) AS net,
         rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(v.packs, 0) DESC) AS fast_rank,
         rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(v.packs, 0) ASC) AS slow_rank
  FROM mart.dim_medicine m LEFT JOIN vol v ON v.medicine_id = m.medicine_id
  WHERE m.is_current AND m.medicine_key <> 0 AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)) SELECT generic_name AS medicine, therapeutic_class AS class, packs,
                         round(net, 0) AS "net sales (USD)", round(net / NULLIF(packs, 0), 2) AS "net per pack (USD)",
                         fast_rank AS "volume rank"
                  FROM ranked WHERE cold_chain_flag ORDER BY net DESC

  WHERE (a.year_month || '-01')::date > b.last_month - ($window || ' months')::interval
  GROUP BY 1),
ranked AS (
  SELECT m.medicine_id, m.generic_name, m.therapeutic_class, m.disease_category, m.cold_chain_flag,
         coalesce(v.packs, 0) AS packs, coalesce(v.net, 0) AS net,
         rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(v.packs, 0) DESC) AS fast_rank,
